record.field: SELECT so.id AS order_id, so.name AS order_ref, so.date_order::date AS order_date, so.state AS order_state, rp.name AS customer_name, COALESCE(pt.name->>'en_US', pt.name->>'default', 'Product') AS product_name, sol.product_uom_qty AS qty_ordered, sol.qty_delivered AS qty_delivered, sol.price_unit AS price_unit, sol.discount AS discount_pct, sol.price_subtotal AS subtotal, sol.company_id AS company_id FROM sale_order so JOIN sale_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = so.id JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = so.partner_id JOIN product_product pp ON pp.id = sol.product_id JOIN product_template pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE so.company_id IN :company_ids AND so.date_order >= :date_from ORDER BY so.date_order DESC, so.id DESC

SELECT customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_ordered AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_qty, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(subtotal AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(TRY_CAST(subtotal AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS avg_line_val FROM raw_dataset GROUP BY customer_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_ordered AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_qty_sold, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(subtotal AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(TRY_CAST(price_unit AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS avg_price FROM raw_dataset GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT order_state, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_count, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_ordered AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS ordered_qty, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_delivered AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS delivered_qty, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_delivered AS DOUBLE)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_ordered AS DOUBLE)), 0), 1) AS delivery_rate_pct, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(subtotal AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_amount FROM raw_dataset GROUP BY order_state ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT strftime(CAST(order_date AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m-%d') AS sale_day, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_count, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(subtotal AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS daily_revenue FROM raw_dataset GROUP BY sale_day ORDER BY sale_day ASC

SELECT sm.id AS move_id, sm.date::date AS move_date, sm.state AS move_state, COALESCE(pt.name->>'en_US', pt.name->>'default', 'Product') AS product_name, COALESCE(pp.default_code, '') AS product_sku, src_loc.complete_name AS source_location, src_loc.usage AS src_usage, dest_loc.complete_name AS dest_location, dest_loc.usage AS dest_usage, sm.product_uom_qty AS qty_demanded, sm.quantity AS qty_done, sm.company_id AS company_id FROM stock_move sm JOIN product_product pp ON pp.id = sm.product_id JOIN product_template pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id JOIN stock_location src_loc ON src_loc.id = sm.location_id JOIN stock_location dest_loc ON dest_loc.id = sm.location_dest_id WHERE sm.company_id IN :company_ids AND sm.date >= :date_from ORDER BY sm.date DESC, sm.id DESC

SELECT product_name, product_sku, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN dest_usage = 'internal' AND src_usage != 'internal' THEN TRY_CAST(qty_done AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_imported, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN src_usage = 'internal' AND dest_usage != 'internal' THEN TRY_CAST(qty_done AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_exported, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN dest_usage = 'internal' AND src_usage != 'internal' THEN TRY_CAST(qty_done AS DOUBLE) WHEN src_usage = 'internal' AND dest_usage != 'internal' THEN -TRY_CAST(qty_done AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_change FROM raw_dataset GROUP BY product_name, product_sku ORDER BY net_change DESC

SELECT move_state, COUNT(move_id) AS total_moves, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_demanded AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_qty_demanded, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_done AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_qty_done FROM raw_dataset GROUP BY move_state ORDER BY total_moves DESC

SELECT source_location, dest_location, COUNT(move_id) AS move_count, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_done AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_qty_moved FROM raw_dataset GROUP BY source_location, dest_location ORDER BY total_qty_moved DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT strftime(CAST(move_date AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m-%d') AS move_day, COUNT(move_id) AS moves_count, ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST(qty_done AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_qty_transferred FROM raw_dataset GROUP BY move_day ORDER BY move_day ASC
